evidence.modelCannotForge: PermissionEvaluationRequest.Subject 来自 Tool + Invocation；Requirement 来自 ToolDefinition；ToolInput 只用于 InputHash，不作为决策输入
evidence.providerCannotBypass: Provider 消费 Broker.Dispatch 之后的已授权 Invocation；无直接 Provider → Kernel 路径
evidence.osSeparation: OS Authorization 在 Platform Adapter 层；Kernel Grant 在 PermissionBroker；两者独立
evidence.failClosed: Unknown permission → Deny (broker.go:86-93)；ScopeResolution → scope_denied；Grant Expiry → Deny
